# CJ Browning Insurance Agency

> Local Farmers Insurance agency in Scottsdale, Arizona, offering property & casualty (P&C) insurance for individuals, families, and businesses.

CJ Browning Insurance Agency is an independently owned and operated Farmers Insurance agency based in Scottsdale, AZ. It helps residents of Scottsdale and the greater Phoenix Valley (including Paradise Valley, Phoenix, Tempe, Fountain Hills, and Cave Creek) get insured through Farmers Insurance products.

## Services

- Auto insurance
- Homeowners insurance
- Renters insurance
- Condo insurance
- Landlord insurance
- Umbrella insurance
- Business / commercial insurance
- Motorcycle insurance
- Boat & RV insurance
- Flood insurance

## Key facts

- Type: Independent local Farmers Insurance agency (InsuranceAgency)
- Location: Scottsdale, Arizona, 85251, USA
- Service area: Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, Phoenix, Tempe, Fountain Hills, Cave Creek, and the broader Phoenix metro area
- Phone: (480) 555-0142

- Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM MST

- Arizona minimum auto liability limits (for reference, subject to change): 25/50/15 — $25,000 bodily injury per person, $50,000 per accident, $15,000 property damage
